name: Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Tatooine)
description: This OOM command battle droid was present on Tatooine with the Head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Count Dooku and his IG-100 MagnaGuards while they were waiting for Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, who were carrying the son of Jabba Desilijic Tiure the Hutt, Rotta.
